title: Pushout of an extension is postcomposition in Ext
statement: Let $X$ be a ringed space and let $0\to\mathcal A\to\mathcal B\to\mathcal C\to0$ be a short exact sequence of $\mathcal O_X$-modules with Yoneda class $\delta\in\operatorname{Ext}^1_X(\mathcal C,\mathcal A)$, with Ext as in [def-sc-ext-sheaf]. For every morphism $\varphi:\mathcal A\to\mathcal W$, the pushout short exact sequence $0\to\mathcal W\to\mathcal B\amalg_{\mathcal A}\mathcal W\to\mathcal C\to0$ has Yoneda class $\varphi[1]\circ\delta\in\operatorname{Ext}^1_X(\mathcal C,\mathcal W)$.
